_readme: U.S. CPSC recalls and warnings for e-bikes, e-trikes and e-bike batteries. Every entry must link to cpsc.gov and carry the date we checked it. Warnings mean CPSC told people to stop using a product and no fix was offered. Run `node tools/build-recalls.js` after editing.

notices.title: CPSC: don't buy or use "universal" chargers for e-bikes and other micromobility products
notices.detail: CPSC named the SafPow and AMPOWSURE brands as a fire hazard. Use only the charger made for your battery.

items.product: Urban Arrow Family, Shorty, Cargo L/XL and Tender 1000/1500 cargo e-bikes
items.hazard: Seat-post bolt can break, causing a fall
items.remedy: Free repair: new seat post and saddle

items.product: Q20 and Q20 Lite e-bikes
items.hazard: Front wheel can come off, causing a crash
items.remedy: No fix offered. Stop using it.

items.product: CARBO folding e-bikes, Models X and S
items.hazard: Missing required reflectors; Model X has no chain guard. Crash and cut hazards
items.remedy: No fix offered. Stop using it.

items.product: Q20 and Q20 Pro e-bikes
items.hazard: Battery and wiring can catch fire
items.remedy: No fix offered. Stop using it; remove the battery and dispose of it as hazardous waste.
